title: Review cycle 2: PASS
body: All 7 defects verified fixed at specific plan lines; new factual claims re-checked against game.js bytes; no new defects. Verification chain now layered honestly: static harness = construct presence, auditor diff = sacred/scope guard, md5 = frozen-three, screenshots = pixel truth.

reasoning: Grid minmax(0,1fr) + internal log scroll is the canonical fit pattern; harder options pay negative (scale blurs text/breaks touch targets; accordion adds logic).
dvh is the purpose-built primitive for the iOS URL-bar bug, broad support since 2023, graceful vh fallback; JS path barred by presentation-only anyway.
Grid-pinned commands keep log+actions co-visible with zero markup reorder and no toggle state; sticky/fixed have iOS toolbar quirks; tabs hide one of the two things that must both be visible.
Single-emission .bridge scoping is sufficient and safest; a class hook crosses the logic line for no added isolation.
Node static harness keeps the gate dependency-free; constructs-not-pixels blind spot closed by mandatory live screenshots.
S2 is the non-cheap, correct path: protects the curated dashboard via a zero-code env seam.

Global 44px min-height is cheap-flavored: monotonic-floor argument is false for layout (min-height bumps can force wraps/overflow/blown row math on flex-grid rows of two screens this phase never visually verifies); node harness blind + zero markup diff proves nothing about CSS reflow.
new_chosen: E1 travel-only, UNLESS colony+voyage <=900px screenshots are added to the DoD evidence

ruling: Keep E2 (global 44px floor) WITH the DA's condition satisfied: colony and voyage <=900px live screenshots become mandatory DoD evidence alongside the travel screenshots.
reasoning: The DA's overturn was conditional; the condition (real layout evidence for the two unverified screens) costs two extra screenshots in an evidence pass the orchestrator is already running. Accessibility payoff retained, blast radius now verified instead of argued.
